content: पञ्जिका .²1 A perpetual or running commentary which explains and analyses every word; टीका निरन्तरव्याख्या पञ्जिका पदनक्तिका. .²2 A journal, a book in which accounts of receipts and expenditure are entered. .²3 The record or register of human actions kept by Yama. (For other senses see पञ्जि above).
